plugin.name: google-mail
plugin.description: Send, read, and manage Gmail emails
plugin.context: Use for all Gmail email-related tasks including sending messages, searching conversations, and managing drafts

send_email.description: Compose and send an email message
send_email.usage_context: When user wants to send a new message to specific recipients via Gmail

x-variable-mapping.description: Extract content from attachment or file object

send_immediately.description: Send email immediately or save as draft

options.description: Optional email settings (send immediately, request read receipt)

max_recipients.message: Cannot send to more than 50 recipients at once. Please reduce the recipient list.

external_domains.message: This email includes recipients outside your organization. Continue?

no_subject.message: Send email without a subject line?

output_schema.description: Confirmation of sent email with identifiers

sent_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when email was sent

recipient_count.description: Total number of recipients (to + cc + bcc)

common_errors.auth_failed: Your Gmail connection has expired. Please go to Settings → Connected Apps to reconnect Gmail.
common_errors.quota_exceeded: You've reached your daily email sending limit. Please try again tomorrow or contact support to increase your limit.
common_errors.invalid_recipient: Some email addresses are invalid. Please verify the email addresses and try again.
common_errors.attachment_too_large: One or more attachments exceed the 25MB limit. Please reduce file sizes or use cloud sharing links.
common_errors.api_rate_limit: Too many requests in a short time. Please wait a moment and try again.
common_errors.insufficient_permissions: Gmail permissions are insufficient. Please reconnect with full email sending permissions.

search_emails.description: Search for emails in the user's Gmail account
search_emails.usage_context: When user wants to find specific emails or conversations in their Gmail

parameters._comment_required_change: AGENTKIT_OPTIMIZATION: Removed 'query' from required to allow OpenAI AgentKit to call search_emails() without parameters. The gmail-plugin-executor.ts already handles empty queries by defaulting to 'in:inbox'. This reduces validation failures and improves AgentKit reliability.

query._comment_default_added: AGENTKIT_OPTIMIZATION: Added default empty string. When omitted, executor defaults to 'in:inbox' search.
query.description: Search query (supports Gmail search operators like 'from:', 'subject:', 'in:', etc.). Leave empty or omit to search all inbox emails.

max_results.description: Maximum number of emails to return

include_attachments.description: Include and process email attachments in results (forces content_level to 'full')

content_level.description: How much email content to fetch: 'metadata' (headers only, fastest), 'snippet' (~200 char preview, good for filtering/classification), 'full' (complete body, needed for extraction/deep analysis)

max_results.message: Cannot search for more than 100 emails at once.

large_search.message: Search for {max_results} emails? This may take longer to process.

snippet.description: Email preview snippet (first ~200 chars of email body - USE THIS for content matching/filtering)

body.description: Email body text (NOTE: Usually empty in search results - use 'snippet' field instead for email content)

attachments.description: Attachment metadata (if include_attachments=true). Each item contains: filename, mimeType, size, attachment_id (use with get_email_attachment), message_id (email ID)

message_id.description: Email message ID (required for get_email_attachment action)

search_query.description: The search query that was executed

emails.subject: Project Update
emails.snippet: Here's the latest update on the project including next steps and timeline...

common_errors.auth_failed: Your Gmail connection has expired. Please reconnect in Settings → Connected Apps.
common_errors.invalid_query: The search query format is invalid. Please check your search terms and try again.
common_errors.no_results: No emails found matching your search criteria. Try different keywords or broader search terms.
common_errors.api_rate_limit: Too many search requests. Please wait a moment and try again.

create_draft.usage_context: When user wants to prepare an email for later sending or review via Gmail

get_email_attachment.description: Download email attachment content for processing
get_email_attachment.usage_context: Use when you need to extract or analyze content from email attachments (PDFs, images, documents). First search emails with include_attachments:true to get attachment IDs.

message_id.description: Gmail message ID containing the attachment

attachment_id.description: Gmail attachment ID from search_emails result

filename.description: Original filename for reference (optional but recommended)

is_image.description: True if attachment is an image

common_errors.auth_failed: Gmail connection has expired. Please reconnect in Settings → Connected Apps.
common_errors.attachment_not_found: Attachment not found. Check if email still exists or try searching again.
common_errors.size_exceeded: Attachment exceeds 25MB limit. Gmail API cannot download larger files.
common_errors.download_failed: Failed to download attachment. Try again or contact support if issue persists.

modify_email.description: Modify email labels — mark as important, apply/remove labels, mark read/unread
modify_email.usage_context: When you need to mark an email as important, apply a label, remove a label, or mark as read/unread

add_labels.description: Label names or system labels to add (e.g. 'IMPORTANT', 'STARRED', or custom label name like 'AgentsPilot')

remove_labels.description: Label names or system labels to remove (e.g. 'UNREAD', 'INBOX')

mark_important.description: Shorthand: if true, adds 'IMPORTANT' label; if false, removes it

mark_read.description: Shorthand: if true, removes 'UNREAD' label; if false, adds it

common_errors.auth_failed: Gmail connection has expired. Please reconnect in Settings → Connected Apps.
common_errors.message_not_found: The specified message ID does not exist or has been deleted.
common_errors.label_not_found: The specified label does not exist and could not be created.
common_errors.insufficient_permissions: Gmail modify permissions are insufficient. Please reconnect with full email access.

get_or_create_label.description: Find a Gmail label by name, or create it if it does not exist
get_or_create_label.usage_context: When you need a label to apply to messages and want to reuse it if present or create it once if absent. Idempotent — re-running returns the same label without creating a duplicate.

label_name.description: Name of the label to find or create. Matched case-insensitively against existing labels.

output_schema.description: The resolved label with a flag indicating whether it was newly created

created.description: True if the label was created by this call, false if it already existed

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the action completed

common_errors.auth_failed: Your Gmail connection has expired. Please reconnect in Settings → Connected Apps.
common_errors.label_conflict: The label name conflicts with an existing label and could not be resolved. Please try a different name.
common_errors.api_rate_limit: Too many requests in a short time. Please wait a moment and try again.
common_errors.insufficient_permissions: Gmail modify permissions are insufficient. Please reconnect with full email access.

list_labels.description: List all Gmail labels in the user's account
list_labels.usage_context: When you need to enumerate available labels (system and/or custom) — for example to pick a label to apply or delete.

common_errors.auth_failed: Your Gmail connection has expired. Please reconnect in Settings → Connected Apps.
common_errors.api_rate_limit: Too many requests in a short time. Please wait a moment and try again.
common_errors.insufficient_permissions: Gmail read permissions are insufficient. Please reconnect with full email access.

delete_label.description: Delete a Gmail label by ID
delete_label.usage_context: When you need to permanently remove a custom label. Messages keep their content but lose this label. Built-in system labels cannot be deleted. Re-running on an already-deleted label succeeds (already absent).

label_id.description: Gmail label ID to delete (custom labels only — system labels cannot be deleted)

confirm_delete_label.message: Delete the label '{label_id}'? Messages keep their content but lose this label.

deleted.description: True when the label no longer exists after this call

already_absent.description: True when the label was already gone (404) — deletion was a no-op

deleted_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the action completed

common_errors.auth_failed: Your Gmail connection has expired. Please reconnect in Settings → Connected Apps.
common_errors.label_not_found: The specified label does not exist.
common_errors.cannot_delete_system_label: Built-in Gmail labels (INBOX, SENT, etc.) cannot be deleted.
common_errors.insufficient_permissions: Gmail modify permissions are insufficient. Please reconnect with full email access.

reply_to_email.description: Reply within an existing email thread
reply_to_email.usage_context: When you need to respond to a specific message and keep the reply in the same conversation. Sets threading headers (In-Reply-To/References) and the thread ID so the reply continues the thread rather than starting a new one. NOT idempotent — each call sends a new message (re-running double-sends).

message_id.description: The message being replied to. Used to resolve the thread, the original Message-ID (for In-Reply-To/References) and the subject (Re: …).

x-variable-mapping.description: Extract the message id from an upstream email entity

content.description: Reply content — at least one of body or html_body is required

to.description: Override the reply recipients (defaults to the original sender)

recipients.description: Optional recipient override. When omitted, replies to the original sender (Reply-To ?? From).

reply_all.description: When true and no explicit recipients are given, include the original To/Cc set (self-exclusion is not performed).

max_recipients.message: Cannot reply to more than 50 recipients at once. Please reduce the recipient list.

external_domains.message: This reply includes recipients outside your organization. Continue?

message_id.description: Gmail message ID of the sent reply

thread_id.description: Gmail thread ID the reply was sent into

in_reply_to.description: The original Message-ID this reply references

recipient_count.description: Total number of recipients (to + cc + bcc)

sent_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the reply was sent

common_errors.auth_failed: Your Gmail connection has expired. Please reconnect in Settings → Connected Apps.
common_errors.message_not_found: The message you are replying to does not exist or has been deleted.
common_errors.invalid_recipient: One or more recipient addresses are invalid. Please verify and try again.
common_errors.api_rate_limit: Too many requests in a short time. Please wait a moment and try again.
common_errors.insufficient_permissions: Gmail send permissions are insufficient. Please reconnect with full email access.

send_draft.usage_context: When a draft has been prepared (e.g. via create_draft) and you now want to send it. NOT idempotent — sending consumes the draft; a re-run will fail because the draft no longer exists.

draft_id.description: Gmail draft ID to send (as returned by create_draft)

x-variable-mapping.description: Extract the draft id from an upstream create_draft result

message_id.description: Gmail message ID of the sent message

thread_id.description: Gmail thread ID of the sent message

draft_id.description: The draft ID that was sent (now consumed)

sent_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the draft was sent

common_errors.auth_failed: Your Gmail connection has expired. Please reconnect in Settings → Connected Apps.
common_errors.draft_not_found: The specified draft does not exist or has already been sent.
common_errors.api_rate_limit: Too many requests in a short time. Please wait a moment and try again.
common_errors.insufficient_permissions: Gmail send permissions are insufficient. Please reconnect with full email access.

batch_modify_emails.description: Add/remove labels or archive across many messages in one call
batch_modify_emails.usage_context: When you need to apply the same label change (add, remove, or archive) to a set of messages at once — for example labeling or archiving a backlog. Bounded to 1000 message IDs per call (Gmail's maximum). Idempotent — re-applying a label or removing an absent one is a no-op.

message_ids.description: The message IDs to modify (1..1000). Empty arrays are rejected.

add_labels.description: Label names (system or custom) to add to every message. Custom names are resolved/created.

remove_labels.description: Label names to remove from every message.

archive.description: Shorthand: archive the messages by removing the INBOX label.

max_ids.message: Cannot modify more than 1000 messages in a single batch. Please split into smaller batches.

large_batch.message: Apply this label change to {message_ids_count} messages?

modified_count.description: Number of messages the modification was applied to

message_ids.description: The message IDs that were modified

labels_added.description: Resolved label IDs that were added

labels_removed.description: Resolved label IDs that were removed (includes INBOX when archive=true)

modified_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the batch completed

common_errors.auth_failed: Your Gmail connection has expired. Please reconnect in Settings → Connected Apps.
common_errors.too_many_ids: Too many message IDs in one batch. The maximum is 1000 per call.
common_errors.label_not_found: One of the specified labels does not exist and could not be created.
common_errors.api_rate_limit: Too many requests in a short time. Please wait a moment and try again.
common_errors.insufficient_permissions: Gmail modify permissions are insufficient. Please reconnect with full email access.
